building: Zeta Beta Tau — Alpha Alpha, Purdue University
grader: Independent subagent; evaluator written from direct source and Blender data review; does not import builder validators.

criteria.name: Correct identity and source-backed footprint
criteria.assessment: PASS, with documented historic GIS label conflict. Current chapter contact and homepage identify ZBT at 900 David Ross; the captured national chapter photo shows ZBT/Alpha Alpha and the same address, while the GIS FID 762 at that address retains historic Phi Kappa Theta/SOFKH. The crosswalk compares 2007, 2017, 2018, and 2026 evidence and properly resolves this as one physical site while noting transition/shared-occupancy uncertainty. The building shell and roof plan ring independently agree with all 12 GIS vertices.

criteria.name: Position, orientation, and scale/dimensions
criteria.assessment: Strongly supported in horizontal location and plan shape by the source ring in the repository coordinate transform. The building occupies the same campus-world XY as the GIS ring; the main shell and roof ring match to float precision. Plan orientation comes from that mapped polygon. Its bounds and dimensions remain map-outline estimates rather than a surveyed wall-face measurement, and the chosen photo-facing edge is inferred, so a small deduction applies.

evidence.frontage_selection: longest GIS edge, not georeferenced facade alignment

criteria.name: Evidence-backed height, floors, and roof form
criteria.assessment: Flat/low-slope roof and shallow parapet are consistent with the captured chapter photos and aerial imagery. The 7.65 m height and two-floor interpretation are clearly labeled as estimates; the GIS NUM_LEVELS=1 conflict and absence of a measured elevation make these less than fully verified.

evidence.height_status: photo-guided estimate; no surveyed vertical datum
evidence.story_count_status: estimated from photos; GIS legacy value conflicts
evidence.roof_form_status: photo/aerial supported; pitch and elevation uncertain

criteria.name: Facade, entrances, and distinctive architecture
criteria.assessment: The light broad facade, regular glazing, large timber-railed deck, ZBT sign, and stair are recognizable from the saved national/current chapter imagery. The render contains a continuous deck and railings with repeated window bays. The images do not supply a georeferenced elevation or reliable entry-door location; unseen elevations and some window placement remain schematic, so this receives partial credit.

criteria.name: Modular export, portability, and complete evidence
criteria.assessment: PASS. Stable scene/collection names and asset path are present, the collection contains the dedicated building meshes, the project has a dedicated reproducible build script and source/evidence folder, and independently inspected Blender data show no nonempty external image dependencies. Existing fresh reopen/linked append logs use the same exact frozen SHA and report success.

findings: Historic GIS naming conflict is acknowledged rather than silently overwritten: the asset represents the currently documented ZBT facility at 900 David Ross, while transition timing and possible temporary shared occupancy remain unresolved.
Treat the polygon-derived shell as a GIS roof/map-outline proxy, not a surveyed wall footprint; the GIS geometry and Shape__Area field are inconsistent and the imagery has canopy/seam occlusion.
Retain explicit uncertainty on the 7.65 m height, story count, frontage-edge choice, window rhythm, door position, and unpictured sides; these are not surveyed facts.
